summary: Backend API testing completed for FP&A Planning Versions, FP&A Drivers, Loan Covenant Monitoring, and Multi-Entity Consolidation features. All 62 tests passed (43 new + 19 existing).
seed_data_creation: Test companies exist: 'Test Company UK' (GBP) and 'US Division' (USD). Loans and covenants created during testing are cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs for FP&A, Loans, Covenants, and Consolidation are fully functional. FX rates use MOCK data (MOCK_FX_RATES dictionary). Covenant types must use exact enum values: 'DSCR', 'ICR', 'Leverage', 'Current Ratio', 'Quick Ratio', 'Minimum Cash', 'Maximum CapEx', 'Net Worth', 'Custom'.

FP&A Planning Versions: POST /api/fpa/versions - Create version (Budget, Forecast, Actuals, Scenario)
GET /api/fpa/versions - List versions with filters (company_id, version_type, fiscal_year)
POST /api/fpa/versions/{id}/copy - Copy version with new name
FP&A Overview: GET /api/fpa/overview - Get overview stats (versions, drivers, entities count)
Loans: GET /api/loans - List loans with filters (company_id, is_active)
GET /api/loans/{id} - Get single loan with associated covenants
PUT /api/loans/{id} - Update loan (outstanding_balance, interest_rate, notes, is_active)
DELETE /api/loans/{id} - Delete loan and associated covenants
Covenants: POST /api/covenants - Create covenant (DSCR, ICR, Leverage, etc.)
GET /api/covenants - List covenants with filters (company_id, loan_id, status, is_active)
GET /api/covenants/{id} - Get single covenant with measurement history
DELETE /api/covenants/{id} - Delete covenant and measurement history
GET /api/covenants/summary/status - Get summary of covenant statuses
FX Rates (MOCKED): GET /api/fx/rates - Get FX rates relative to base currency
Consolidation Groups: GET /api/consolidation/groups - List groups with entity details
POST /api/consolidation/groups/{id}/consolidate - Run consolidation with FX conversion
Consolidation Results: GET /api/consolidation/entity-summary - Get entity summary by currency/region

mocked_apis_list: FX rates use static MOCK_FX_RATES dictionary (USD=1.0, GBP=1.27, EUR=1.08, etc.)
